embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: Zebra3D: Efficient Hybrid Foundation Models For Scalable 3D Reconstruction
fields.value: AMD; Tencent and Google appear only as citations to baseline models the authors benchmark against (HunyuanWorld-Mirror is a Tencent model, VGGT/π³ are associated with Google-adjacent prior work), not as author affiliations. — Feed-forward 3D foundation models (e.g., VGGT, HunyuanWorld-Mirror, π³) reconstruct scenes from unposed images, but their global self-attention scales quadratically with view count, limiting them to modest numbers of views; the authors report attention accounts for 88% of VGGT's runtime at 512 views

fields.name: What 30,000 Hours of Ego-centric Video Does Not Teach
fields.value: Toyota Research Institute; keeping as a comparable top-tier industrial research lab, for user judgment.** Academic co-affiliations: UIUC, CMU, Johns Hopkins. — The paper studies how far scaling ego-centric human video (30,000 hours, 1,000+ scene types, 14,000+ contributors) can push video world models as an alternative to physics-based simulators.

fields.name: SpaceFlow: Locally Controllable 3D Generation
fields.value: Microsoft; Microsoft is listed identically to the two confirmed academic affiliations, so this is not a "Google Scholar"-style false positive, but the per-author mapping is unverified.** — SpaceFlow is a training-free pipeline for locally controllable 3D generation from text and a set of geometric primitives, where each primitive acts as a per-part proxy with its own control strength.

fields.name: PriMoRetarget: Humanoid Motion Transfer Through Prioritized Motion Retargeting
fields.value: NVIDIA — PriMoRetarget is a framework for retargeting human motion onto humanoid robots, covering single-character motion, human-object manipulation, and human-human interaction.

fields.name: PointVGGT: Zero-Shot Multiview RGB-D Point Cloud Registration with Visual Geometry Foundation Priors
fields.value: Alibaba Group — The paper addresses registering unordered multiview RGB-D scans into one metrically consistent coordinate frame.

fields.name: Phase-aware video generation for physics-grounded dynamics and interactions (PAVG)
fields.value: SenseTime; kept and flagged). Other authors: Nanjing University, Shenzhen University of Advanced Technology (academic). — The paper targets physically plausible video generation for scenes where solids and gases behave differently but interact (e.g., smoke, fire, water with solid objects).

fields.name: No Distillation Needed: Single-Pass Real-Time Talking Heads via Acausal Noise Shaping
fields.value: Meta Reality Labs — Real-time audio-driven facial animation for avatars must generate each output frame from only the audio received so far (streaming/causal), but diffusion models — the current state of the art — need many network passes per frame, which is a poor fit for this setting.

fields.name: LiteNWM: Efficient Latent World Models for Onboard Visual Navigation in the Wild
fields.value: Sony AI — LiteNWM is a latent navigation world model for visual robot navigation that shares visual encoding across candidate trajectories and predicts their action-conditioned future representations at multiple time horizons, with a learned scorer choosing among them.

fields.name: Learning to Retrieve: Internalizing Memory Retrieval for Video World Models (L2R)
fields.value: Xiaomi EV; Xiaomi is not on the default list but is a comparable large-scale tech company — Video world models generate explorable, 3D-consistent scene video from camera trajectories, and existing systems use external memory to retrieve earlier content and limit scene drift.

fields.name: LeWAM: A JEPA World Action Model with Diffusion-Steering-Based MPC
fields.value: NVIDIA — LeWAM is a bidirectional transformer that performs forward dynamics, backward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and policy prediction on a shared, decoder-free JEPA latent, trained end-to-end across all four modes.

fields.name: IntactWorld: Joint World Modeling with Intact Features
fields.value: KOKONI 3D / Moxin Technology — The authors argue video generation models produce realistic visuals but lack genuine understanding of real-world logic, and that prior methods absorbing "world knowledge" compress features, losing structural information.

fields.name: GenIA: Generative Reconstruction with Test-Time Input Alignment
fields.value: Meta Reality Labs — Generative 3D models can hallucinate plausible geometry for unseen parts of an object from one or a few views, but their outputs often don't match the observed geometry, appearance, or pose.

fields.name: DreamTrue: Action-Faithful Robot World Model with Counterfactual Post-Training
fields.value: Alibaba Group / Amap — DreamTrue is a multi-view, cross-embodiment robot world model trained to predict videos that follow given actions and stay physically plausible.

fields.name: Controllable Exaggeration for Generative Motion Models via Training-Time Adaptation and Inference-Time Guidance
fields.value: Autodesk Research; acknowledgments separately state the work was "supported by Autodesk Research and the Autodesk AI Lab." **Flag: Autodesk is not on the explicit tracked-company list; keeping as a comparable top-tier industry lab for character-animation tooling (comparable to Adobe), for user judgment.** — The paper addresses the Exaggeration principle of traditional animation — largely absent from recent physically-plausible motion generative models — and proposes a two-stage framework to add it to existing text-to-motion pipelines.

fields.name: Conditional Residual Prediction: Improving Autoregressive Video Diffusion without a Bidirectional Teacher
fields.value: Tencent Hunyuan — The paper studies causal (autoregressive) video diffusion models, which suit streaming and long-video generation but typically underperform bidirectional models of the same size.
